I was concerned about all the comments surrounding replacement filters leaking and causing property damage. I really don't want to come home to a pool in my house.

So far I haven't seen any issues, we did the whole "fill it with water before installing and then run a crapton of water through it before letting it fill the ice cube trays", etc. and now the water seems nice and clear, runs at a good rate, and the autistic boy who periodically visits my home and complains about the status of my filters seems to be appeased... at least with this filter.

I chose this product for 1) its good reviews 2) ARKSEN brand. When I received this item it had various issues that had not ever been described in its description.
1) Water inlet pipe can not be fitted to a standard outlet (I tried several of them).
2) There is no mechanism for "Rinse" while the instructions in the Amazon website absolutely did not say about it. From the instructions, I found we need to remove the clothes after washing, rinse without cloth and then rinse with cloths! It means this machine even worsen the process of washing!
3) Drain outlet should keep upward until it finishes the washing cycle and then put it in whatever to drain. Overall, it means this machine is a fully hand-washing mechanism+just a motor and a timer!
4) Most importantly and painfully, and probably the main reason that I am returning it, I found their is no instructions regarding how to use the "Spin Dry Basket". In the package I received the manual did not even say a word or diagram to show how to fix the basket on top of the rotor. It simply says: Because our products are subject to constant improvement, diagrams and accessories may differ for your product" It means to me that even ARKSEN did not want to print a few pages to add more details of what a customer may deserve.

I do not expect a fully automatic machine but it could have at least some automatic cycles for rinsing and spinning with just adding 2 automatic switches.

I've done several loads in this portable washer, let me share some observations.
1. I used it on the counter next to the sink, it drains very fast this way.
2. Use a tiny amount of detergent, like a teaspoon or less.
3. The clear plastic walls allow you to see how well the unit is actually working.
4. The spin dryer does not work. It might work for a pair of socks or underwear, but for anything else, forget it.
5. The marking on the knobs is hard for me to see so I painted them black.
6. The included hose is too short and oddly shaped at the end to be used so I add water using a plain old clothes washer hose threaded onto the faucet.
7. The biggest load I've done was two full size bed sheets and one pillow case, all with no problems. It took three rinse loads to get most of the foam to go away.
8. It's nearly impossible to run this without splashing some water around.
9. The handle on the back, which you cannot see in the photos is a nice and valuable feature.
10. If I could speculate based on the way it feels, the cycle timer will be the first thing to wear out on this machine.
11. As far as I can tell the difference between normal wash and gentle wash is the delay before the aggitator in the bottom changes direction.

All the elitist complaints in the other reviews are valid but I say..... "Suck it Up!"  .......  this is a Great little plastic washing machine for $64 dollars!  I just put it in the shower and fill it from my hand-held shower head. I wash the clothes, drain the dirty water, rinse off the clothes with the shower-head while the machine is draining the dirty water.....refill the machine with clean water, rinse, drain the dirty rinse water and then spin. I set the machine on a towel in the shower to prevent the black-marks that the washing-machine -eet leave on the floor of the shower. During the spin cycle I put the hamper beside the washing machine and it stops it from "walking" during the spin cycle. I love this thing and it passes muster with my landlord who said I could not have a washing machine because it would overload the New England Septic System.  I use about 3 teaspoons of laundry soap. My jeans came out great. The directions are a little hard to read because it reads like a bad foreign language translation but.....I'm a Girl and I figured it out!

Another reason for buying this is that it has the spin dryer too. Its okay for the price we are paying. You cant expect professional drying.

Cons:
